text.tspan: L4 vs L7 load balancer: what it can read decides what it can do
L4 load balancer: AWS NLB, kube-proxy
Very fast · keeps the client's IP
Can't route by path: it never reads HTTP
Any TCP / UDP: databases, DNS, game servers
L7 load balancer: ALB, nginx, Envoy, Ingress
Routes by host name, path or header
Can do auth and WAF rules
